in_sanskrit.name: नादधृत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who holds or controls sound or music.

in_marathi.name: Nadadhrita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Eloquent in Speech
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nadadhrita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit roots 'nada' (sound, melody) and 'dhrita' (supported), Nadadhrita signifies one who is eloquent in speech, with a melodious voice.
